question: Can the proposed parser preserve streaming behavior without buffering the complete input?
purpose: Determine whether the design is feasible before committing to the production parser architecture.
why_prototype: The critical behavior depends on interaction between the parser state machine and the existing async reader.
baseline: src/parser.rs currently accepts complete byte slices
tests/streaming.rs contains the representative chunk boundaries
shared_constraints: Do not introduce new production dependencies
evidence_required: A test that feeds the same document in at least three chunk sizes
Evidence that the implementation does not collect the full input before parsing

variants.design: Keep explicit incremental parser state between read chunks.
implementation_plan: Add a prototype incremental state object under prototypes/state-machine/
Adapt the existing token transition logic without changing the public Parser type
Add a focused harness that feeds variable chunk sizes
Record peak buffered bytes for the representative fixture
success_criteria: All chunk-size cases produce the baseline parse tree
Peak buffered bytes remain below the full fixture size
